criteria.reason: The workout exercise menu includes a “Skip Exercise” option.
Selecting it opens a confirmation dialog before applying the skip.
Skipping sends every set with status `skipped`, and the server persists that status.
The card checks for all sets skipped and displays “Skipped” before its completion or partial status.
When all sets are skipped, the menu offers “Unskip Exercise” during the workout.
The existing `POST /sets` endpoint accepts and stores set status, including `skipped`.
The diff adds no server test for skip or unskip.
The diff adds no client test for the skip UI.
The harness reports all 197 server and 289 client tests passing.
The added UI copy is direct and contains no exclamation marks.
